bug_semantics: CWE-502/CWE-552 scanner denylist miss: picklescan flags pickle GLOBAL/STACK_GLOBAL imports only if they appear in _unsafe_globals; builtins.open and shutil are listed to block arbitrary file writes, but distutils.file_util.write_file is omitted, so a crafted pickle REDUCE of that API is reported safe while overwriting attacker-chosen files.
evidence: CVE-2025-71321 is PUBLISHED on cveawg.mitre.org (not rejected); GHSA-m273-6v24-x4m4 withdrawn_at is null; GHSA type reviewed, pip picklescan <0.0.33 patched 0.0.33. Advisory PoC is pickle REDUCE of distutils.file_util.write_file. At v0.0.32, src/picklescan/scanner.py _unsafe_globals contains builtins/__builtin__ 'open' and shutil '*' but not distutils.file_util; match is unsafe_filter=_unsafe_globals.get(module) so unlisted modules are non-dangerous. First-write of that denylist matcher and of scanner.py is c1d5abdcc740e0d08a0d12d015d08e1e6f29a67e (2022-09-05, Implement Pickle scanner) adding _suspicious_globals without distutils/open/shutil and matching via _suspicious_globals.get(g[0]). git cat-file -p c1d5abd: author/committer Matthieu Maitre <mmaitre314@users.noreply.github.com>, single parent 6a76b8c3ac67dc04181e600614ecf2a423cca326. git cat-file -e 6a76b8c3:src/picklescan/scanner.py fails. git log -1 --format='%an %ae %cn %ce' c1d5abd => Matthieu Maitre mmaitre314@users.noreply.github.com Matthieu Maitre mmaitre314@users.noreply.github.com. No Co-Authored-By/Generated-with/bot on that object. Later 1c86244 added open and 15c0dbd added shutil (incomplete expansions of the same denylist, not first-write of the miss). Direct closure is 70c1c6c31beb6baaf52c8db1b6c3c0e84a6f9dab (2025-12-26, Fix various vulnerabilities #53), ancestor of v0.0.33, adding distutils.file_util '*' (and citing this GHSA). Parent d3273f42 still lacks that key. Author Matthieu Maitre mmaitre@live.com; committer GitHub noreply@github.com.
reasoning: The advisory is a real denylist gap, not withdrawn. The scanner treats unlisted pickle globals as safe; distutils.file_util.write_file was never on the list until 0.0.33. Those matcher+table lines first appear in c1d5abd, the smallest surviving first-write of src/picklescan/scanner.py; the parent boilerplate tree lacks that path so introducer_parent_absent is true. Adding open/shutil later did not introduce the distutils hole. The BIC object is the human founder (Matthieu Maitre) with no AI markers, so the verdict is NOT_AI. Fix is 70c1c6 in v0.0.33.
